tooltip.walking_cane.dash: Right-click while the dash key is unbound; otherwise use the dash key. Dashes in the movement-input direction (look direction while idle), costs 1 durability, %ss cooldown
tooltip.walking_cane.teleport: Sneak + right-click while the teleport key is unbound; otherwise use the teleport key. Teleports to the surface ahead, consuming all configured items in the other hand
tooltip.walking_cane.teleport_range: Range: %s + %s blocks per consumed item; 10s cooldown
